g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Bed contour sampled once at pillow contact; door knob and pillow cushion retain separate editable dot rows. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry: bed, pillow and door surfaces lower grey; silhouettes and knob boundary higher black. Exterior and under-bed gap white/unraised. No material code or measured height.
